verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships AI features (First Pass AI, GenAI DDQ, AI Helpbot, an MCP server), so whether customer data is used for model training is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence item documents a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any related data-use control. The AI Helpbot transparency article only says answers come from approved support content, which says nothing about training on customer data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
